name: vershiny
description: Open-source аналог PeakFinder: панорама горизонта и подписи вершин (PWA, офлайн-first)

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && vite build --config vite.sw.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" index.html install.html vite.config.ts vite.sw.config.ts tsconfig.json public/manifest.webmanifest .github/copilot-instructions.md README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" index.html install.html vite.config.ts vite.sw.config.ts tsconfig.json public/manifest.webmanifest .github/copilot-instructions.md README.md
